definitions.gloss: health checkup; health screening; medical examination
definitions.explanation: A general health examination to check one's overall physical condition. Short for {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}. Includes routine checkups at workplaces and community health screenings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{健診|けんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Have a health checkup once a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健診|けんしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかった→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧。
examples.english: Something came up in my company health checkup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}→乳幼児：14882_nyuuyouji⟧{健診|けんしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実施|じっし}している→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。
examples.english: Infant health checkups are provided free of charge by municipal governments.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧. In Japan, annual health checkups are mandated by law for employees. Community-based screenings are also widely offered for residents.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧, which refers to screening for a specific disease (e.g., ⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧, cancer screening). {健診|けんしん} is a general checkup; ⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧ targets a specific condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健診|けんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to have a health checkup)
- {健診|けんしん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (checkup results)
- {定期|ていき}{健診|けんしん} (regular health checkup)
- ⟦{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}→乳幼児：14882_nyuuyouji⟧{健診|けんしん} (infant health checkup)
